name: True Items Redux
teaser: Overhaul of PlinioJRM's original TrueItems mod
description_html:
If PlinioJRM requests it to be taken down then I’ll take it down as this is his original mod with a bunch of edits by me.

This is a overhaul/redux of the TrueItems mod by PlinioJRM

I changed a lot of item stacking amounts (mostly barter)

I also added in 30 items that I felt should have been there already.
